title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a **Senior QA Automation Engineer** to own quality across APIs, asynchronous workflows, automation, performance, security, and AI-assisted testing.

What You’ll Do

* Build and maintain **Playwright** UI/API automation frameworks.
* Test **REST, gRPC, GraphQL** APIs, schemas, authentication, negative scenarios, and contracts.
* Test async flows using **RabbitMQ/SQS/webhooks**, including retries, ordering, idempotency, and DLQs.
* Create and analyze **JMeter** load, stress, soak, and spike tests; track p95/p99 latency and bottlenecks.
* Perform hands-on **security/VAPT testing** using Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Nikto, or SQLMap.
* Use **AI-assisted testing** for test generation, automation, self-healing, visual testing, and LLM feature testing.
* Drive exploratory, risk-based, and manual testing alongside automation.
* Build CI/CD quality gates using **Jenkins, Pact/OpenAPI**, and automated test reporting.
* Validate application data using **SQL, logs, queues, and observability tools**.
* Mentor QA engineers and drive defect management and quality metrics.

Must Have

* 4–5 years of QA experience.
* Strong **Playwright** automation experience.
* Expert hands-on **API testing**.
* Strong **async/event-driven testing** experience.
* Strong **JMeter/performance testing** skills.
* Hands-on **security/VAPT** experience.
* Experience with **AI-assisted testing**.
* Strong manual, exploratory, and risk-based testing skills.
* Programming experience in **TypeScript/JavaScript**, plus Java or Python.
* Hands-on **Jenkins/CI/CD** and **SQL** experience.

Good to Have

**Pact, RabbitMQ/SQS, axe-core/WCAG, AWS/LocalStack, WireMock, Testcontainers, k6/Gatling, Allure, distributed tracing, and chaos testing.**

You’ll Thrive Here If

You enjoy finding bugs in complex async systems, explaining performance issues to developers, investigating security vulnerabilities, and combining **strong automation with hands-on exploratory testing**.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ahmedabad, Gujarat

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
We are looking for a **QA Automation Engineer** who is strong in manual testing and interested in building hands-on automation skills. You will work across functional testing, API testing, Playwright automation, and performance testing using JMeter.

You’ll work closely with the Senior QA Automation Engineer to ensure product quality across every release and help improve the team's test automation practices.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze requirements and create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases using appropriate test design techniques.
* Perform **functional, regression, integration, smoke, and exploratory testing**.
* Conduct API testing using **Postman**, including collections, environments, scripts, authentication, and HTTP validation.
* Develop and maintain UI and API automation tests using **Playwright**.
* Create, execute, maintain, and extend performance/load testing scripts using **JMeter**.
* Validate asynchronous workflows by tracing events across queues, databases, and application logs.
* Perform database validation using **SQL**.
* Identify, document, and track defects in **Jira** with clear reproduction steps.
* Collaborate with developers and other QA engineers to identify and resolve quality issues.
* Contribute to improving test coverage, automation, and overall QA processes.

Required Skills

**Must Have:**

* 2–4 years of QA/testing experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in **Manual Testing**.
* Good understanding of **STLC/SDLC** and test design techniques such as:
* Boundary Value Analysis
* Equivalence Partitioning
* Decision Tables
* State Transition Testing
* Hands-on experience with **API Testing** using Postman.
* Familiarity with **Playwright** – locators, assertions, auto-waiting, and basic fixtures.
* Familiarity with **JMeter** – thread groups, samplers, listeners, and basic correlation.
* Hands-on **SQL** knowledge for test data and database validation.
* Basic programming knowledge in **JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python**.
* Understanding of modern QA concepts such as test pyramid, shift-left testing, risk-based testing, eventual consistency, idempotency, and latency.

Good to Have

* Knowledge of **microservices and asynchronous systems**, including queues, retries, and Dead Letter Queues (DLQ).
* Experience with **Git/Bitbucket and Jenkins**.
* Basic understanding of **OWASP Top 10** and exposure to Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP.
* Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools.
* Understanding of contract testing concepts.
* Accessibility testing knowledge, including axe checks, keyboard navigation, and WCAG basics.
* Experience identifying and troubleshooting flaky tests.
* ISTQB Foundation certification.

What We’re Looking For

You’ll be a great fit if you:

* Enjoy finding edge cases that others may overlook.
* Can write clear and reproducible defect reports.
* Want to automate the tests you perform manually.
* Are curious about how systems work beyond the UI.
* Are comfortable learning new testing tools and technologies.

Tech Stack

**Manual Testing:** STLC, Test Design, Exploratory Testing, Jira  
**API:** Postman, REST  
**Automation:** Playwright  
**Performance:** JMeter  
**Database:** SQL  
**Programming:** JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python  
**CI/CD:** Bitbucket, Jenkins

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ahmedabad, Gujarat
